description: Save a territory on the rep's MedaRep account from a metro, county FIPS codes and/or ZIP codes, optionally with its procedure family; it then shows under /territories and in my_territories. Saving under an existing territory's name replaces it. The plan limits how many territories are kept. Use only when the user asks to save one.

counties.description: 5-digit county FIPS codes forming a custom territory.

family.description: Procedure family key from coverage (e.g. knee-arthroplasty, lumbar-fusion) or a plain name.

metro.description: Metro area by name ("Charlotte") or 5-digit CBSA code (16740). Can cross state lines.

name.description: The territory's name, e.g. "South Charlotte knee".

zips.description: 5-digit ZIP codes forming a custom territory (as my_territories returns them).

name: save_territory
title: Save a custom territory
